patterns.what: intro: the kit, then the steel guitar's strums, then the upright
groove: strums, the palm-muted riff, upright, shaker
build: piano stabs, distorted guitar; the turn: toms, a chime rising, a violin swell
world: tablas, darbuka, the violins' drone, the flute in D Hijaz
peak: the tenor sax's solo in Hijaz, congas, tablas, the kit back, violin stabs
outro: flute and sax trade, the drums thin; the last timpani and a grabbed crash
